description:
§42.2.3 — the soft-deprecated in-place presence guard inside a markup `${ … }`, over a reactive `T | not` cell (`${ given @user :> {

${@user.name}

} }`), surfaces W-GIVEN-PRESENCE-DEPRECATED (Info; exactly 1) and is accepted: inside the guard `@user` is narrowed, so the member read is not E-TYPE-046. CODES HALF ONLY: impl#1 lowers `given @cell` to a bare name and drops the markup body (g-top-level-given-emits-bare-name-s459, fixed by #1380), so the run-time half is not asserted here.
rationale:
§42.2.3 (S462) — the in-place guard in markup context is SOFT-DEPRECATED (canonical: `${ if (@user is given) { … } }`, or `

`, §42.4) and surfaces W-GIVEN-PRESENCE-DEPRECATED; §42.3.5 item 2 — the guard narrows its receiver. Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a, go".
